filesplit.drop.split: Drop the file to split here, or click to choose one
filesplit.drop.join: Drop in every piece, or click to choose them (the order sorts itself out)
filesplit.status.idle: Files stay in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
filesplit.say.splitReady: Add a file and pick how big each piece should be.
filesplit.say.joinReady: Add every piece — the number at the end of the name sets the order.
filesplit.err.missing: A piece is missing or out of order (slot {list}). Check that you added them all.
filesplit.err.tooSmall: This file is smaller than one piece, so there is nothing to split.
filesplit.say.splitDone: Split into {n} pieces. If the joined file gives this same value, it is byte-for-byte the original — {digest}…
filesplit.say.joinDone: Joined {n} pieces and downloaded {size}. Checksum {digest}… — if it matches the one from splitting, the file is byte-for-byte the original.
